records.title: Sparse Binary Transformers for Multivariate Time Series Modeling
records.reason: The paper evaluates sparse binary Transformers on multivariate time-series classification, anomaly detection, and forecasting; fixed/causal attention masks plus binary weights reduce storage up to 53x and FLOPs up to 10.5x. The mechanisms are concrete but the evaluated domain is time-series rather than language-model inference.

records.title: Adaptive Modulation and Coding for Underwater Acoustic Communications Based on Data-Driven Learning Algorithm
records.reason: The article uses DNN BER estimation and DDQN to adapt modulation, coding, and transmit power for underwater acoustic links. Its energy-efficiency target is radio communication, not transformer or LLM inference.

records.title: Multi-Token Prediction Needs Registers
records.reason: MuToR inserts register tokens for multi-token prediction during pretraining/fine-tuning. Full text says auxiliary registers are removed at inference and do not change inference graph latency; relevance is limited to training objective and a linked parallel-decoding lineage.

records.title: Poison as Cure: Visual Noise for Mitigating Object Hallucinations in LVMs
records.reason: The paper studies visual noise as a way to mitigate object hallucinations in large vision models. The method addresses output reliability, not model inference compute, memory, latency, or serving.

records.title: Quasar-ViT: Hardware-Oriented Quantization-Aware Architecture Search for Vision Transformers
records.reason: Quasar-ViT applies hardware-oriented quantization-aware architecture search to vision transformers. It has concrete hardware/quantization methods, but experiments target vision models and do not establish transfer to LLM inference.
